answer:
I turned your Spanish verbs note into a game called Verb Rush. It's on the note's App side, and the automated layout and contrast checks came back clean. I haven't played it on a phone myself.

- **How it plays:** Each round lasts 60 seconds. You get a verb and pick the right answer from four choices. Most prompts go Spanish to English, and about 30% go English to Spanish.
- **Scoring:** Each correct answer scores 10 points times your combo (the combo tops out at 5×). A wrong answer breaks the combo and costs 4 seconds.
- **After a round:** You get a list of the verbs you missed to review.
- **Progress:** It saves your best score and your daily-play streak. Each verb moves from new to learning to mastered. Verbs you miss come up more often.
- **Your note:** The game reads the verbs from your table, so new rows show up automatically. You need at least 3 rows to play.

On a Mac you can also answer with the 1–4 keys.
